findings.rule: Title block heat treatment field must not be blank or '---' when a heat treatment note is specified on the drawing.
findings.reasoning: The title block heat_treatment field is '---', but note N1 explicitly requires case hardening to 55–60 HRC with a 0.8–2 mm case depth. A manufacturer reading only the title block would skip heat treatment entirely, producing a soft part that fails in service.
findings.correction: Update the title block heat_treatment field to reference N1 (e.g., 'CASE HARDEN 55-60 HRC PER NOTE N1') so the requirement is unambiguous.

findings.rule: Hole depth should generally not exceed 10× diameter for standard drilling without special process controls.
findings.reasoning: Feature F4 specifies a Ø4.2 mm hole (D14) drilled 50 mm deep (D15), giving a depth-to-diameter ratio of nearly 12:1. This exceeds standard twist-drill capability and risks drill wander, breakage, and poor hole straightness.
findings.correction: Reduce the through-hole depth if functionally possible, drill from both ends to meet in the middle, or specify a gun-drilling / deep-hole drilling process.

findings.rule: Functional outer diameters on mating or locating features require an explicit tolerance or fit class.
findings.reasoning: The outer diameter Ø30 (D1, D13) of this pin sleeve has no tolerance assigned. As a sleeve, the OD is almost certainly a locating or press-fit surface; relying on the general machining tolerance of ±0.8 mm (for the 6–30 mm range) would allow unacceptable looseness or interference.
findings.correction: Add an appropriate tolerance or fit class (e.g., h6, h7, or a specific dimensional tolerance) to the Ø30 outer diameter dimensions.

findings.rule: Functional inner bores on sleeves require an explicit tolerance or fit class.
findings.reasoning: The inner bore Ø20 (D4, D12) carries no tolerance. For a pin sleeve the ID typically guides or locates a pin; falling back on the general machining tolerance of ±0.5 mm (for the 6–30 mm range) is far too loose for any functional fit.
findings.correction: Assign a suitable tolerance or fit class (e.g., H7, H8, or a specific bilateral tolerance) to the Ø20 bore dimensions.
